description: This Java source file defines the IntellijApiDetector class, an Android Lint API detector customized for IntelliJ IDEA. It uses PSI (Program Structure Interface) to analyze Java code for API compatibility issues, such as class, method, and field usage restrictions based on API levels, and handles annotations like @TargetApi and suppression annotations.

classes.name: IntellijApiDetector
classes.description: A custom Android Lint detector for IntelliJ IDEA that analyzes Java source code using PSI to identify API compatibility issues, such as unsupported class, method, or field usage based on API levels, and handles annotations like @TargetApi and suppression annotations.

methods.name: getApplicableNodeTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of AST node types (CompilationUnit) this detector applies to.

methods.name: createJavaVisitor
methods.description: Creates an AST visitor that initiates the API check on compilation units.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs PSI-based analysis of the Java file to identify API issues, running within a read action.

methods.name: getTargetApi
methods.description: Retrieves the target API level from @TargetApi annotations by traversing PSI elements upwards.

methods.name: codeNameToApi
methods.description: Converts a build code string to an API level integer using SdkVersionInfo.
